method.purpose: offline rough memory scenarios for unchanged max(256,isqrt(E/256)); no runtime fallback
method.lifecycle_scope: 43 archived flat32 cases, 4 languages, two merge budgets, sizes 1/4/16/32 MiB and one 512 MiB holdout; requested retirement excludes final model teardown
method.cutoff_brackets: sum exact archived capacity bins below and above cutoff; retired bytes bracket is exact for each archived trace
method.current_29k_calibration: exact full-run R256; estimate R890 shape using same-input 16k 512/1024 B ratios; keep wide full-inventory bounds separately
method.allocator_model: local measured malloc_usable_size padding; add nominal 8 B in-use chunk header per live small allocation as a sensitivity model; ignores heap fragmentation and thread-arena page residency
method.extrapolation: fixed rule budget, same-language new unique material; physical edges scaled by largest observed input ratio; use observed local power slopes as scenarios, not a universal law or confidence interval
method.larger_blocks: predicted >2^32 positions use generic block dictionaries; flat histograms do not validate their actual RSS; directory buffers, growth and local-list repartition are unmodeled
method.risk: no quantitative probability or no-peak guarantee; linear retirement is a stress case; chunk reservation is not resident RSS
